authentication: none (optional premium key; polite pool via mailto=)
cost_notes: free at research volume; premium/pay-as-you-go tiers are commercial and were not used
free_tier: free, no key required; polite pool via mailto; paid premium tiers exist
historical_coverage: works from the 1600s; metadata quality strong from ~1900; affiliations improve after 2000
known_limitations: created_date is the metadata-ingestion clock, NOT a publication clock; using it would fabricate look-ahead
publication_date is frequently the journal issue date, not the first-online date
author affiliations are free-text strings plus ROR-linked institutions; the ROR entity 'company' type is the reliable hook
awards/funders are incomplete for industry-authored work, so funder-based company links under-count
full snapshot exists on S3 but was not probed here, hence bulk = PARTIAL
licence: CC0 1.0 for the data; OpenAlex terms of use for the service
rate_limits: free API ~10 req/s and 100k/day (help centre); premium keys higher; we paced at 0.8s
research_value: Largest open scholarly index with DOI/PMID linkage and ROR-linked affiliations; gives MedRadar the author-affiliation signal for the five firms at a scale Crossref/PubMed cannot match, and publication_date is usable as first-public-visibility once issue-date records are discounted.
